localizedDescription:
DISTRICT 2 – BERNAM STREET - New Mixed Development in the Heart of Tanjong Pagar

One Bernam is a new development by HY-MCC (Bernam) Pte. Ltd.  Strategically located in Bernam Street, strategically location within the vibrancy and heart beat of the Central Business District.  Comprising a total of 351 units, this development has a unit mix of  1-Bedroom, 2-Bedroom, 2-Bedroom+Study, 3-Bedroom, Penthouse.

A conservation district located within the Central Business District in Singapore, Tanjong Pagar has a collection of historical architecture pieces with modern skyscrapers, with over 200 beautiful shop houses built between 1870 and 1940.  One Bernam boasts a 360 degree panoramic view with both city and sea views.

One Bernam has a wide array of recreation facilities such as the Wellness Lifestyle decks and The Tatami Garden where residents will be able to unwind with the leisure deck, chill out deck, yoga deck and relaxation corner.  For residents who enjoy a active lifestyle, there is a Sky Fitness Club with a sky gym, active deck and fitness deck.  For nature lovers, there is The Botanic Collection where they will be able to enjoy four themed gardens and a alocasia walk.

Project Highlights:

Within the vibrancy & heartbeat of the CBD

Within the epicentre of Greater Southern Waterfront Transformation!

Minutes walk to Prince Edward MRT Station (U/C) and Tanjong Pagar MRT

Close Proximity to lifestyle and F&B amenities (Tanjong Pagar Plaza, Icon Village, Maxwell Food Centre, 100AM)

Project Details:

Developer: HY-MCC (Bernam) Pte. Ltd.

Address: 1 Bernam Street, Singapore 078852

Property Type: Private Condominium

Tenure: 99 Years Leasehold

Total Units: 351

Unit Mix: 1-Bedroom, 2-Bedroom
